names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Μαΐου, «Όσιος Ιωάννης ο Ψυχαΐτης», with the rank word left off; the epithet ο Ψυχαΐτης is kept in the display name and not in this form.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 26. мај ст. ст., „Преподобни Јован Психаит“ — Преподобни is the `venerable` this corpus puts in `types` and is the only word stripped. **Психаит is kept, and keeping it is what keeps this folder out of the bare-«Јован» fold**: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Јован Психаит» and nine holders of a bare «Јован», which `john-of-gothia` had to join on 19 May and which `john-vladimir` was kept out of on 22 May for the same reason. **The epithet is not a rank**: the Greek page’s own couplet turns on it as a description of the man, and the body makes it the lavra’s name, so it is part of the name and not a word `honorific.js` would compose. The Greek form on this folder, «Ιωάννης», is the bare one and is left alone.

The heading of the calendar’s name link, «Иоанн Психаит, исповедник, прп.», with the two rank words after the comma left off; the day’s own line gives the same two words. The epithet is the lavra the life names. `fk.mjs` returned NONE for «иоанн психаит» before the write, and the bare «Иоанн» was deliberately not stored — that string heads the largest fold in this corpus.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 мая ст. ст. — «Прп. Иоанна Психаита исп (IX).»

attestations.note: The identification is exact: the line gives the Psychaite lavra in his name and the grade «исп.», confessor, both of which this folder already holds, and its Greek and Serbian rows keep him on the same Julian day. `dates` IS UNCHANGED AND THE CALENDAR CONTRADICTS ITSELF INSIDE ONE PAGE: the folder holds a `floruit` of «8th century» off the Охридски пролог; the day line prints «(IX)», the ninth; the life’s first sentence says «жил в конце VIII - начале IX века», at the end of the eighth and the beginning of the ninth, which is wider than either; and its last sentences make the persecuting emperor «Льва Исавра (717 - 741)», Leo the Isaurian, whose reign is in the FIRST half of the eighth century and cannot contain a man who lived at the end of it. Three readings on one page and a fourth in the folder; nothing was widened, narrowed or replaced, and all of them are in the paragraph. What the Russian adds and the paragraph carries: the leaving of the world in his young years and the tonsure in the Psychaite lavra in the suburb of Constantinople, the gift of driving out demons and healing sicknesses, the summons to interrogation and the demand that he renounce the veneration of the icons and write his renunciation, his rebuking the persecutors and calling the emperor a heretic instead, and the exile in which he died after much hardship from the iconoclasts. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Ιωάννης ο Ψυχαΐτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The epithet is what tells him from every other John**, and the page's couplet makes it a play on the word: bearing the relation of the soul alone, father, you are justly called Psychaites — «Ψυχῆς μόνης σὺ τὴν σχέσιν φέρων Πάτερ, / Ψυχαΐτης κέκλησαι ἐνδίκως μάκαρ». The page does not say what the Psycha was, so nothing is claimed about a monastery of that name. **`confessor` is in `types` because the page says the iconoclast emperors persecuted him and he came back from each persecution**, not because it uses the word. **No year and no place**: the page dates him only by «τα χρόνια της σκληρής πάλης για τις άγιες εικόνες», the years of the hard struggle for the holy icons, which is a period and not a date, so `dates` is absent. It is also the same page that gives him no country, no monastery, no relics and no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 08.06.2026 (26. мај ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Јован Психаит“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of the 23 to 26 May is. **A DAY NO OTHER CALENDAR KEEPS HIM ON**: saint.gr keeps him on 7 May, this book on 26 May, and the Romanian and Russian rows are `undocumented`. So the row is written on the 26/5 and the Greek row is left on the 7/5. The day list for the menologion 26/5 could not see him for that reason, and **`sr-namesweep.mjs` found him because the heading carries his epithet** — which is the clean division this wave works by, the sweep scoring a heading and finding a folder kept on another menologion day. **THREE THINGS SAINT.GR SAYS IT DOES NOT HAVE, THIS BOOK HAS.** The existing life ends „That is the whole of the notice: no country, no monastery, no emperor named, no year, no relics and no hymn.“ The Prologue gives **the monastery** — „повукао у лавру Психаитску“, the Psychaite lavra, which is the lavra his epithet is made of and which the Greek page never names — **the city**, Constantinople, and **the century**, the eighth. It still names no emperor and no year of birth or death. **A FIRST DATE, AND IT IS A FLORUIT AND NOT A DEATH.** „У VIII веку трпео изгнанство због иконопоштовања“ — in the eighth century he suffered exile for the veneration of icons. **A century stated for an event in a man’s life is a `floruit`, not a `death`**, and it is written as one: `earliest` 701, `latest` 800, display `8th century`, `basis: "traditional"`, with the book’s own words in the note. **No death year is derived from it and none is invented**; the folder had no `dates` object at all before this. **The exile is the event dated, not his repose**, and that is said in the note so that no later reader reads the interval as a lifespan. **New besides**: that **he withdrew from the world in his early youth** and **struggled in that lavra many years for the love of Christ**. `venerable` and `confessor` are both corroborated — the ascetic years and the exile for the icons — and **no type was added**. `related` stays empty: the entry names nobody. No `locations`, although Constantinople is named — and the Prologue naming it is the one thing that would make a `locations` possible on this folder, which is left for the author. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

floruit.note: Охридски пролог за 08.06.2026 (26. мај ст. ст.): „У VIII веку трпео изгнанство због иконопоштовања“. The century is stated for his exile, which is an event in his life, so it is held as a floruit and not as a death; no year of birth or death is stated by any calendar read for this folder, and none is derived here. saint.gr sets him „in the years of the hard struggle for the holy icons“ and says nothing narrower.
